mapper.select: SELECT research_no FROM admin_research_visibility WHERE hidden_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY hidden_at DESC, research_no DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_research_visibility ( research_no, hidden_yn, hidden_by, hidden_at, restored_by, restored_at ) VALUES ( #{researchNo}, 'Y', #{hiddenBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NULL, NULL ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE hidden_yn = 'Y', hidden_by = VALUES(hidden_by), hidden_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, restored_by = NULL, restored_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_research_visibility SET hidden_yn = 'N', restored_by = #{restoredBy}, restored_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE research_no = #{researchNo}
